//: Code surface to required doc couplings, checked by the docs-in-sync skill against the current diff. A rule fires when a changed file matches a 'when' glob and is unmet when no changed file matches a 'require' glob.

rules.name: Data model -> DATA-MODEL.md
rules.note: Storage layout, sidecar schema/lookup, or project lifecycle changes update the data-model doc.

rules.name: Pipeline -> PIPELINE.md
rules.note: Thresholds, region semantics, flag formulas, stitching, screenplay classification, and export behavior are documented in PIPELINE.md. core/models.py is here because the shared dataclasses (ExportOptions, StitchLog, the screenplay element stream) are the pipeline's contracts.

rules.name: Engines/models -> ENGINES.md
rules.note: Server lifecycle, engine roles, manifest contract, and download behavior live in ENGINES.md.

rules.name: UI/jobs -> UI-JOBS.md
rules.note: Threading model, signal flow, and canvas behavior live in UI-JOBS.md.

rules.name: User-observable behavior -> user docs
rules.note: A change users can see (a control, a workflow step, an output difference) updates the wiki and, if affected, the README.

rules.name: Release plumbing -> RELEASING.md
rules.note: Asset names, build steps, and the release procedure are documented in RELEASING.md.
